articles.title: Casio launches new affordable Tank-style MTP-B190 watches with 50 m water resistance
articles.description: Casio has launched four new MTP-B190 rectangular analog watches with 50 m water resistance, mineral glass, and leather or steel options. The Tank-style quartz models measure 41 × 31.5 mm and are set for a March 2026 release.

articles.title: Apple launches iPhone 17e and new iPad Air: Check prices, storage, features and availability
articles.description: Apple unveiled the iPhone 17e with an A19 chip, 48MP camera, and Ceramic Shield 2, starting at $599 with 256GB storage. Pre-orders begin March 4. The company also launched an upgraded iPad Air powered by the M4 chip, featuring enhanced performance and a Liquid Retina display, also starting at $599.
